Toucan 1.0.19

  • Explain… for emails. When the final check blocks an email, Explain… on its row in the client’s Originals list shows where each value was found (a header, the plain text or HTML, an attachment’s name), the words as written and the words around them. Select a row: if a change to your lists fixes it, a button makes the change, then choose Tokenise Again. If not, Copy Description copies where it is and how it’s written, never the words, to send to Rob Eades.
  • Fewer emails blocked. A phone number Toucan already knows is now tokenised when it’s written as plain digits without its first 0, as Excel stores it. A file is also tokenised a second time when a number found partway through it appears earlier in another form, such as a Teams meeting’s conference ID.
  • A name running straight into a longer Keep value, such as a person’s name before the firm’s name in a signature, is now tokenised. Keep only protects a value it covers in full.
  • Clients whose Originals are in OneDrive are much quicker. Files OneDrive keeps online only are no longer downloaded just to update lists; the Originals list shows them as Online only, and Scan downloads and reads one.

Toucan 1.0.18

  • See where a name was found. In Seed, Check All and a file’s check, point at a value’s Found column to see the words around it, or click the magnifying glass beside it for every place it was found: the file, the sheet and cell, line, page or slide, the words around it with the name in bold, and Open to open the file. These are shown only in that window, never saved.
  • Correct a value before adding it. If only part of a name was found, such as Asset Management for Smith Asset Management, click the value and type it in full before you choose Add.
  • Seed opens straight away and lists names as it reads each file, with a Stop button. You can choose while it reads; Add is ready once it has finished.
  • Checking again is much quicker. Scanned pdf files and images are read once while Toucan is unlocked, so Check Again only looks for names again. Locking Toucan forgets them.
  • Seed and Scan All no longer make Toucan pause between files, and Add no longer waits while every file is counted again.

Toucan 1.0.17

  • Names that are part of another are joined. When checking a file or transcript, a value that is part of another, such as Smith beside Smith Limited, sits under it in orange and starts as its alias, so both get one token. If Smith is someone else, choose Replace for it instead.
  • Values going to Replace come first in the check, and the Aliases column says why a row has no suggestions: choose a category such as Person or Entity to see them.
  • Adding a global correction from a transcript now starts on Only when unsure only if the speech engine was unsure of the words you selected, so a rule for clearly heard words changes them straight away.
